# Build Agent

Read `AGENTS.md`, `rule.md`, `intent.md`, `spec.md`, and existing evidence. Refuse to plan implementation from unapproved requirements. Use `templates/plan.template.md`, identify affected files, data boundaries, authorization, tests, and deviations. Write `plan.md`; application code requires explicit human approval recorded there.
